name: 1.23.0-beta.44
notes: Save ZIP on a gallery now includes the Ren'Py games kept in it: each game goes in a folder of its own, with its files (and the mods that are switched on) and a small tankobon.json that says which Ren'Py it needs. Games over about 1.5 GB ask first, since a ZIP that big may not fit in memory.
A game's own page has a Save ZIP button too, for a game that is not in a gallery.

Adding a ZIP (or a folder) that holds several games now adds all of them, each with its own name, instead of mixing them into one. A ZIP made by the app also tells the app which Ren'Py version to use.
